privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data {company} (“we”) collects in the Lumera service and how we use it.

s1.title: Who we are
s1.body: The data controller is {company}. For any data question write to {email}.

s2.title: What data we collect
s2.body:
Account data: first and last name, e-mail, phone (optional), password as an irreversible hash.

Booking data: service, time, your contact details and comment — received by the specialist you book.

Specialist and studio data: profile, photos and videos, prices, schedule, address.

Technical data: IP address and browser type at login (for security), error logs.

s3.title: Location
s3.body: “Near me” buttons ask for your location in your browser. Coordinates are used only to sort by distance in your browser and are not stored on our server.

s4.title: Why we use data
s4.body: To create and secure your account, process and notify you about bookings, show specialist and studio profiles, accept subscription payments, prevent fraud, comply with the law and improve the service.

s5.title: Who we share data with
s5.body: With the specialist — the booking contact details. With providers that help run the service: hosting, e-mail delivery, payment providers (we never see or store card numbers), OpenStreetMap maps (your browser contacts their servers when a map is shown). With authorities — only when legally required. We do not sell personal data.

s6.title: Cookies
s6.body: We use only strictly necessary cookies: the login session and the selected language. There are no third-party advertising or analytics cookies. If we add them later, we will ask for your consent.

s7.title: How long we keep data
s7.body: Account data — while the account exists. Bookings and payments — as long as required by law and for resolving disputes. After you delete your account, personal data is anonymised.

s8.title: Your rights
s8.body: You can view and correct your data in your account, delete the account under “Security”, and contact us at {email} to access, correct, restrict or erase data, and lodge a complaint with a data-protection authority.

s9.title: Security
s9.body: Passwords are stored as hashes, connections use HTTPS and access is separated by roles. No system is perfectly secure, so please use a unique password.

s10.title: Age
s10.body: The service is intended for people aged 18 and over.

s11.title: Changes
s11.body: We may update this policy; the current version is always on this page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the Lumera service operated by {company}.

s1.title: What Lumera is
s1.body: Lumera is a marketplace where clients find beauty specialists and studios and book them. Services are provided by the specialists and studios themselves; {company} is not a party to the service agreement and is not responsible for service quality.

s2.title: Account
s2.body: You provide accurate data, keep your password secret and are responsible for activity in your account. We may block an account for violating these terms.

s3.title: Bookings and cancellations
s3.body: A booking is confirmed by the specialist. You can cancel or reschedule in your account; a specialist may set their own conditions and must tell you about them. Do not book if you do not intend to come.

s4.title: Reviews
s4.body: A review can be left only after a completed visit. Reviews are moderated; we may reject a review containing insults, spam or false statements.

s5.title: Specialists and studios
s5.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of your profile, prices and schedule, hold the rights to the materials you publish and comply with the law for your activity (including hygiene rules and age restrictions). A profile is published while a subscription is active.

s6.title: Subscriptions and payment
s6.body: Specialists and studios pay a flat subscription under the chosen plan. Prices and conditions are shown on the plans page and may change for future payments. You can cancel in your account; access remains until the end of the paid period. If payment fails, a grace period applies, after which the profile is hidden.

s7.title: User content
s7.body: You keep the rights to the photos and videos you upload and grant {company} a free, non-exclusive licence to display them in the service while your profile is active.

s8.title: Prohibited
s8.body: Illegal content, fraud, attempts to hack the service, collecting other users’ data, creating fake bookings and reviews.

s9.title: Liability
s9.body: The service is provided “as is”. To the extent permitted by law, {company} is not liable for indirect losses or for the actions of specialists, studios and clients.

s10.title: Changes
s10.body: We may change these terms; by continuing to use the service after the changes you accept the new version.

s11.title: Governing law
s11.body: These terms are governed by the law of Ukraine, unless mandatory rules where you live provide otherwise.
